# Rules for this project

This is a student's app at the Computhink AI Coding Camp. The student is 12 to 16 years old.

## What the app is

- Read brief.md to understand who the app is for and what it must do.
- Use plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript only. No frameworks, no libraries, no build step, no npm.
- Keep everything in index.html, style.css and script.js.
- Save what the user types on this device (localStorage), so it is still there after a refresh.
- No logins, no accounts, no servers and no data shared between users.
- The app must work on a phone and on a laptop.

## How to work with the student

- Make small changes. Do one thing per request.
- For a new feature, give a short plan in 3 to 5 bullet points first and wait for the student to say go.
- For a bug fix, or a change of words or colours, make the change straight away without a plan.
- Never remove or change features the student did not ask about.
- Do not add extra features. Suggest them and ask first.
- Explain each change in simple words a 13-year-old understands.

## Privacy

- This app and its repository are public.
- Never put real names, photos, addresses or school names in the app or in example data.
- Use made-up example data only, such as "Alex" or "Bubble tea $4".
